notes: Compares separately parsed serde_json::Value with PartialEq; parsing is outside timing and the result is a boolean. preserve_order keeps key order. Equivalent only for this JSON corpus.
details: Uses serde_json::Value PartialEq on separately parsed JSON values. Parsing is outside timing; comparison returns a boolean with no output serialization. preserve_order retains object insertion order, including the reordered-key fixture. Equivalent only for the shared JSON corpus: serde_json distinguishes integer and floating-point number representations.
